basics.name: Pavel Palauniou
basics.label: Cloud | Platform | DevOps
basics.summary: Hello! I'm a Senior DevOps Engineer with expertise in public clouds, automation, and high-available systems. Experienced in optimizing production infrastructure, improving deployment processes, and ensuring system security and stability.

work.name: Sapiens
work.description: Global leader in intelligent insurance software solutions.
highlights: Developed and maintained a robust continuous delivery framework using Bash, Python, and GitLab CI.
Troubleshoot complex issues across Oracle Cloud, AWS, Kubernetes, WebLogic, and various database platforms, ensuring rapid incident resolution and minimal downtime.
Optimized infrastructure as code by refactoring Terraform and CloudFormation scripts.
Identified and resolved critical security vulnerabilities in both OCI and AWS environments, enhancing overall system security and ensuring compliance with internal and external standards.
Designed and implemented a highly available Kubernetes production ecosystem, improving scalability and resilience for business-critical applications.
Led the migration of REST API services from AWS ECS to Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE), streamlining deployments and improving system performance.
Collaborated closely with the R&D department to enhance CI/CD pipelines and modernize cloud infrastructure, accelerating the release cycle and supporting innovation initiatives.
Collaborate with the SRE team to improve production stability.

work.name: Softeq
work.description: Global company specializing in embedded and hardware technology solutions for digital transformation
highlights: Managed AWS EKS clusters across multiple regions, implementing zero-downtime blue-green deployments with Terragrunt, increasing deployment reliability and reducing release-related incidents.
Developed and automated a secure instance update process using HashiCorp Packer, ensuring full compliance with FedRAMP standards. Improved server consistency and reduced manual patching time.
Redesigned CI/CD pipelines by replacing sequential Jenkins builds with Docker-based parallel execution on cloud spot instances, boosting release frequency by 3x and cutting build times.
Integrated AWS Redshift and AWS EMR into the core infrastructure, guaranteeing high availability and meeting strict security compliance requirements for enterprise customers.
Automated deployment workflows and created detailed documentation, streamlining onboarding and reducing deployment errors.
Provided ongoing operational support, monitoring, and incident response, maintaining 99.99% uptime for production environments.

work.name: Godel Technologies Europe
work.description: Godel is a leading, next-generation technology consulting company with some of the most exceptional software engineering talents in Europe
highlights: Took over management of AWS cloud infrastructure within two weeks and resolved performance issues with ElastiCache, ensuring improved system efficiency and stability.
Was the only person providing 24/7 production support for three months, independently handling critical incidents and resolving PagerDuty alerts, often was receiving calls nightly.

work.name: Wargaming
work.description: Wargaming is a leading game developer and publisher
highlights: Implemented SaltStack for configuration management, automating OS updates, user access control, and software installations, which increased update speed and significantly improved predictability and security of system administration.

Designed and deployed a centralized logging system using the ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), improving incident response times through faster access to real-time log data and advanced analytics.
Enhanced the high availability of MySQL databases for Seafile by introducing MariaDB replication, ensuring data integrity and zero service downtime during failover scenarios.
Optimized performance and reliability of the Perforce version control system, reducing latency by 40% and supporting seamless collaboration for large development teams.
Administered and maintained Ubuntu and CentOS servers, overseeing regular backups and disaster recovery planning using EMC Networker and Veeam.
Improved application performance and uptime by fine-tuning Nginx, HAProxy, Tomcat, and underlying infrastructure, handling up to 150,000 daily user requests with minimal latency.

Proactively supported developers by troubleshooting and resolving issues with TeamCity servers and build agents, resulting in a decrease in build failures and significantly improving development team productivity.
Developed comprehensive documentation and operational runbooks, streamlining onboarding and enabling consistent infrastructure management.

work.name: Priorbank JSC
work.description: The largest commercial bank in Belarus
work.position: Senior System Administrator (focus on Linux and HP-UX)
highlights: Administered and maintained two enterprise data centers with HP Superdome servers, ensuring 99.99% uptime and optimal performance for critical business applications.

Managed and implemented Serviceguard clustering and failover solutions on Linux and HP-UX platforms, completing advanced on-site training at HP to further strengthen expertise in high-availability systems.
Automated deployment processes for new application versions across multiple environments using custom PowerShell scripts, reducing deployment time and minimizing human error.
Implemented database mirroring for MS SQL Server, improving data redundancy and enabling near real-time failover with zero data loss.

Developed and deployed a robust, highly available load balancer solution using Nginx, Keepalived, DNS round-robin, and database replication, achieving zero-downtime deployments and uninterrupted user experience.

Offloaded and cached static content at the Nginx layer, optimizing response times and reducing backend resource consumption, enabling the infrastructure to reliably serve over 200,000 connections daily.
Automated OS updates and tool installations on Red Hat systems using Puppet and Bash scripts, cutting update cycles and improving system consistency.
Performed regular firmware updates and hardware maintenance on Itanium-based systems, ensuring hardware reliability and security compliance.
Fine-tuned system performance and configurations for RHEL, HP-UX, and CentOS environments, resulting in an improvement in overall system stability and efficiency.

work.name: R&D Enterprise Horizont
highlights: Independently mastered Debian Linux and implemented a corporate cache proxy server using Squid, significantly improving internet access control, increasing browsing speed and reducing overall bandwidth load.
Negotiated with ISP vendors and successfully upgraded the company’s internet connection from ADSL to fiber optic, resulting in a 5x increase in connection speed and reduction in downtime.

Deployed KVM-based virtualization infrastructure, enabling the organization to transition from physical to virtual machines. This initiative increased server utilization efficiency and reduced hardware costs.
Led office network cabling projects, designing and installing robust network infrastructure to ensure reliable and scalable connectivity for all employees.
Assisted with hardware configuration and troubleshooting, supporting both day-to-day operations and new equipment rollouts, which improved issue resolution times.
Conducted employee training sessions on safe internet practices, increasing cybersecurity awareness and reducing incidents of security breaches.

education.institution: Belarusian State University of Informatics and Radioelectronics
